template_en:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the main character in <Picture 1>, {subject}.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing {pic1_state}.
<Picture 2> is the keyframe of [Shot 2], showing {pic2_state}.
<Picture 3> is the keyframe of [Shot 3], showing {pic3_state}.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a three-beat short story that begins from <Picture 1>, cuts at 00:03.500 to match the keyframe of <Picture 2>, and cuts at 00:07.000 to match the keyframe of <Picture 3>, keeping <Subject 1> consistent across all three beats.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the face, hairstyle and clothing of the main character are retained in every shot.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the video starts exactly from the framing, pose and surroundings of <Picture 1>.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] keyframe): fully_preserved - the composition, pose and surroundings of <Picture 2> are accurately established at the start of [Shot 2].
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] keyframe): fully_preserved - the composition, pose and surroundings of <Picture 3> are accurately established in [Shot 3].

detailed_description:
The target video is a short three-beat story in {style}, with a consistent color palette and a calm, observational rhythm.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, showing {pic1_state}. <Subject 1> {move_1}. The surroundings keep the layout, colors and light of <Picture 1>, and the movement is unhurried so that the opening state stays readable. Light, color and depth of field follow <Picture 1> closely, with the main character kept fully visible in the frame.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to the next beat, whose keyframe corresponds to <Picture 2>, showing {pic2_state}. <Subject 1> {move_2}. The surroundings and the light match <Picture 2>, and the character keeps the same face, hairstyle and clothing as in Shot 1. Natural motion blur follows the faster movement, and the background keeps the depth and light of the keyframe.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to the final beat, whose keyframe corresponds to <Picture 3>, showing {pic3_state}. <Subject 1> {move_3}. The surroundings and the light match <Picture 3>, and the shot settles on a quiet, stable image for the last moment. The camera finishes its movement slowly, and the final composition rests on the character with the same face, hairstyle and clothing as in the earlier shots.

overall_soundscape:
Ambient sound of {sounds}, changing with each location and synchronized with the movement of the character.

non_diegetic_music:
A piano melody at a moderate tempo with soft strings underneath, becoming warmer and fuller in the last shot and fading out at the end.
tips_zh: 圖 2、圖 3 要在工作流程裡分別釘到 3.5 秒和 7 秒，並且也接到參考圖，提示詞才讀得到。
三張圖的主角要是同一個人、同樣的服裝，畫面差異放在場景與動作。
每一段只寫一個動作，不要塞太多事。

template_en:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the dancer whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>, {dancer}.
<Subject 2> is the complete choreography performed in <Video 1>, including its movement sequence, timing, rhythm, body mechanics and spatial path. <Subject 2> transfers only to <Subject 1> and does not carry the appearance, clothing or setting of the source dancer.
<Audio 1> is the supplied music track and is synchronized with the choreography of <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is a single continuous full-body dance shot in which <Subject 1> performs the choreography of <Subject 2> on a stage, set to the music of <Audio 1>, which is reused as the complete final audio.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the face, hair, outfit and body proportions from <Picture 1> are retained for the whole shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the movement sequence, rhythm and body mechanics of the dancer in <Video 1> are transferred to <Subject 1>, while the source dancer's identity, clothing and background are not carried over.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track, and the choreography stays locked to its beat.

detailed_description:
The target video is a {style} dance film in the visual medium of <Picture 1>, with stage lighting, a shallow depth of field and the whole body kept in frame, shot as one continuous take.
[Shot 1] A wide shot frames <Subject 1>, {dancer}, at the center of {stage}, the lighting modeling the figure from above and slightly behind, with long soft shadows moving across the floor. In the first seconds <Subject 1> begins in the opening position of the choreography and moves into it on the first beat. <Subject 1> then performs the choreography of <Subject 2> from the first beat to the last, with the timing, sequence and spatial path of <Video 1> followed throughout. The body keeps real weight: the feet press and slide on the floor, the hair and the hem of the outfit carry the momentum of each turn and settle a moment after it, and the breathing deepens with the effort while the face stays relaxed and focused. The camera arcs slowly around the dancer with small amplitude at slow speed, always keeping the head, hands and feet inside the frame so that no limb is cropped at the key moments of the movement. The lighting follows the figure and shows the arc of every sweeping arm. In the final seconds the choreography of <Video 1> resolves, <Subject 1> settles into the closing pose, and the chest rises and falls with a few slow breaths while the light holds on the figure. The appearance of <Subject 1> stays identical to <Picture 1> throughout, and no appearance, clothing or background of the source dancer in <Video 1> is carried over.

overall_soundscape:
The copied audio of <Audio 1> is the complete audible layer of the video; no extra ambience or effects are layered over it.

non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is directly reused as the complete audience-only score, keeping its original tempo, instrumentation and dynamics, and the choreography is synchronized to its beat.
tips_zh: 參考舞蹈影片請選全身入鏡、背景乾淨、動作清楚的片段，長度 2～15 秒。
舞者圖最好是全身照，臉和服裝才會穩。
動作過快時肢體容易變形，先挑節奏明確的舞步試。

template_en:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the main subject of <Picture 1>, {subject}, including the appearance, outfit and surroundings shown there.
<Video 1> provides the target video's camera movement, cuts and pacing structure only.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> in the setting of <Picture 1> performing a simple action, filmed with the camera movement, cuts and pacing structure of <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the identity, outfit and surroundings from <Picture 1> are retained for the whole shot.
<Video 1> (camera movement, cuts and pacing structure): fully_preserved - the path, speed, amplitude, cut points and rhythm of the camera in <Video 1> are followed throughout, while its people, scenery, objects and colors are not carried over.

detailed_description:
The target video is a {style} shot lit by {light}, with natural color and a shallow depth of field, in the visual medium of <Picture 1>, in which the camera behavior follows <Video 1> from the first frame to the last.
[Shot 1] The scene is built around <Subject 1>, {subject}. In the opening composition <Subject 1> sits in the frame as in <Picture 1>, with the surroundings arranged in clear layers behind, and the light falls evenly across the face and the clothing. <Subject 1> is {action}, with the fabric of the clothing and the hair responding to the air in the scene and the small details of the surroundings staying consistent with <Picture 1>. The camera movement, speed, amplitude, framing changes and any cut timing are supplied by <Video 1>, which is followed exactly while the content in front of the lens is that of <Subject 1> and its surroundings. As the camera moves, the foreground, the subject and the distant background shift against each other with natural parallax, and the subject remains clearly readable at every point of the move. The lighting stays stable, and no new people or objects appear, nor does any content, color or subject of <Video 1> enter the frame. Subtle environmental motion, such as drifting air, fabric or background activity, stays slow and continuous so that it never competes with the camera move, and the first frame of the target video starts in the framing that <Video 1> starts in. In the last moments the camera comes to rest as <Video 1> does, and <Subject 1> holds the final pose of the action.

overall_soundscape:
Ambient sound of {sounds}, kept steady across the whole video.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

<Subject 1> is the visual style established by <Picture 1>: {style_desc}. Only the style is taken from <Picture 1>; its people, objects and composition are not.

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - this visual language is preserved in every frame, and <Picture 1> supplies style only, so none of its photographic or source-content traits are carried over.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): partially_preserved - the identity, hairstyle and clothing from <Picture 2> are retained, while the rendering follows <Subject 1> in medium, line treatment and palette.

[Shot 1] A wide shot shows <Subject 2>, {subject}, in {scene}, rendered in the style of <Subject 1>. <Subject 2> is {action}. The natural elements of the scene, such as plants, clouds, water or fabric, move gently in rhythmic waves drawn with the same strokes as the rest of the picture, and the figure keeps the face, hairstyle and clothing of <Picture 2>, redrawn with the same strokes and colors as the surroundings. Small details such as the folds of the clothing and loose strands of hair are suggested by a few confident marks rather than photographic detail. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> from the side, in the same style, as <Subject 2> {closeup}. Loose outlines and soft color edges shape the face and the clothing, the hair moves lightly and the background blurs into soft washes of color. The lips part slightly and the shoulders lift with a quiet breath. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. The style stays identical to the opening shot, with the same palette, the same line quality and no drift toward realism.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the face of {caster_short}, lit gold from the front while {aftermath}. Sparks fall past the lens, the light slowly cools to pale blue moonlight, and a long breath leaves the lips before the eyes lift toward the sky. The camera holds a static shot.

overall_soundscape: A low magical hum rises with the glowing runes, crackling softly, then a bright rushing whoosh and a deep resonant boom at the release. Mist hisses faintly, cloth snaps in the wind and tiny sparks tick as they fall.

non_diegetic_music: Low sustained strings and a slow wordless choir swelling to a single timpani hit at the release, then thinning to a high shimmering pad that fades out.
tips_zh: 魔法的樣子要寫成具體的形狀和顏色，不要只寫「華麗」。
咒語建議 10 字內；最後一鏡不開口，只留表情和光。
光會照在臉和場景上，是這類特效戲最重要的細節，別刪掉。

name_zh: 子彈時間（凍結環繞）
desc_zh: 純文字生成 5 秒子彈時間：動作瞬間幾乎凍結，鏡頭繞主角轉半圈看見懸在半空的碎片，最後時間恢復。

inputs.default_en: a stuntwoman in a black leather jacket and fitted dark trousers with a short ponytail
leans far back in a mid-air dodge while a window behind explodes outward in a shower of glass shards

inputs.hint_zh: 例：下雨的霓虹小巷夜晚
inputs.default_en: a rain-soaked neon alley at night with pink and blue signs

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic bullet-time effect, hard neon rim light and glistening rain, a medium shot begins at normal speed in {place} as {subject} runs into frame and {action}. Time then slows to an almost complete stop: glass shards, raindrops and sparks hang motionless in the air with the light glinting on each fragment, while the body of the subject stays frozen in the dodge. The camera arcs around the subject in a half circle with large amplitude at slow speed, moving from the front through the side to the back of the frozen moment, so the suspended shards pass the lens one by one. In the last second, time snaps back, the shards fall, the rain streams down and the subject lands and rolls out of the dodge.

overall_soundscape: A sharp window blast and rain at normal speed, then every sound stretches into a deep, low-pitched hum as time stops, with glass tinkles slowed to long, distorted chimes. The sound snaps back at the end with falling glass, a boot slide and a thud on wet pavement.

non_diegetic_music: A low electronic pulse at a slow tempo that deepens in pitch as time freezes, then cuts out as the sound snaps back.
tips_zh: 只選一個瞬間來凍結，畫面才乾淨。
鏡頭轉半圈已經寫好，不需要再加其他運鏡。
若變形，先降低動作複雜度，例如少放碎片。

name_zh: ASMR 氛圍短片（雨窗、茶、輕敲）
desc_zh: 純文字生成 10 秒 ASMR 氛圍片：下雨的窗邊、雙手輕敲和刷動小物件、熱茶冒煙，最後一句輕聲細語，重點在細緻的聲音。

inputs.hint_zh: 例：下雨夜的小木屋窗邊書桌
inputs.default_en: a small wooden cabin at night, lit by a single warm lamp

inputs.hint_zh: 例：木頭小鈴鐺、牛皮紙、陶瓷杯
inputs.default_en: a small wooden bell, a sheet of kraft paper and a ceramic teacup
steaming oolong tea in a ceramic cup
今晚下雨了，慢慢來，不急。

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, very soft low-key lighting, shallow depth of field, a static close shot of a rain-streaked window in {scene}, droplets running down the glass in slow lines and blurry warm lamp light glowing behind them. The camera holds a static shot as one large drop gathers weight and slides down the pane. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of two bare hands resting on a wooden desk, gently tapping and stroking {objects} one at a time. Fingertips tap the wood, brush across the paper and circle the rim of the cup, each touch slow and clear. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a macro shot of {tea}, steam curling upward in the lamp light, as the hands lift the cup an inch and set it down again. A woman with a soft, breathy whispering voice (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] {whisper}</d> while no face appears on screen.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain taps against the window glass with low wind outside and a faint creak of the wooden cabin. Fingertips tap the wood and brush across paper, a ceramic cup scrapes softly on the desk and hot tea steams with a quiet liquid ripple. The wooden bell gives a single dull chime.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
tips_zh: ASMR 重點在聲音細節，建議「小物件」不要超過 3 樣。
這個範本沒有配樂，要加輕音樂可自行改最後一行。
輕聲細語的那句不要太長，10 秒內講完最穩。

name_zh: 城市縮時攝影（日落到夜景）
desc_zh: 純文字生成 10 秒縮時攝影：固定機位拍城市，由傍晚金光到藍調時刻再到夜晚燈火，雲飛快流動、車流變成光軌。

inputs.hint_zh: 例：從高樓天台俯瞰河岸城市的天際線
inputs.default_en: an elevated rooftop view over a river and a dense skyline of towers

inputs.hint_zh: 例：傍晚日落前的金色陽光
inputs.default_en: golden late-afternoon sunlight just before sunset

inputs.hint_zh: 例：深藍夜空與滿城燈火
inputs.default_en: a deep blue night sky with the whole city lit
bridge traffic and a few boats on the river

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action time-lapse photography, ultra-sharp, a wide static shot from a fixed tripod position shows {location}, beginning in {start}. The camera holds a static shot for the entire time-lapse. Clouds race across the sky and their shadows sweep over the buildings, the sunlight turns from gold to orange to pink and then fades into cool blue twilight. Ground-level activity, such as {traffic}, blurs into long streaks of white and red light, small figures flicker past as pale smears, and windows across the towers turn on in rippling waves until the scene ends in {end}, the skyline outlined in glowing points of light.

overall_soundscape: A sped-up city hum swells and recedes, with traffic whooshes passing in rhythmic waves and distant sirens warping as they pass. A faint crowd murmur and the rush of wind over the rooftop run underneath.

non_diegetic_music: A steady ambient electronic pulse at about 110 BPM with sustained synth pads that slowly rise in volume, a soft arpeggio joining in the second half and ending on a held chord.
tips_zh: 縮時攝影只用一個鏡頭、鏡頭固定不動，畫面變化全來自時間流逝。
起始時間和結束時間差異越大（白天到夜晚），效果越明顯。
如果想要人群，可以在「地面動態」補上，但人會變成模糊的光影。

name_zh: 超慢動作水花瞬間
desc_zh: 純文字生成 5 秒超慢動作：主角跳進積水坑，水珠一顆顆懸在半空，鏡頭慢慢跟拍，聲音也被拉低拉長。

inputs.hint_zh: 例：穿黃色雨衣、紅色雨鞋的年輕女生
inputs.default_en: a young woman in a bright yellow raincoat and red rain boots

inputs.hint_zh: 例：從路緣跳進一個大水坑
inputs.default_en: jumping from the curb into a large puddle

inputs.hint_zh: 例：雨後的石板小巷，午後陽光
inputs.default_en: a cobblestone alley just after rain in soft afternoon sun

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, ultra slow-motion at extremely high frame rate, crisp backlight and a shallow depth of field, a low side-angle medium shot follows {subject} in {place}, {action}. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed as both boots hit the surface and the puddle erupts upward in a thick crown of water. Hundreds of droplets hang separately in the air, each catching a pinpoint of sunlight, with ripples spreading in rings across the water and the raincoat fabric rippling and lifting around the arms. The hair floats up and the laughing face is lit from behind by the sun. The droplets begin to fall back slowly as the shot ends.

overall_soundscape: The sound is stretched and lowered in pitch, with a deep, rounded splash, long trailing drips and a soft rumble of water settling. A muffled laugh bubbles up through the slow-motion hush.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, spacious piano melody with a long reverb tail and a soft sustained string pad, swelling slightly at the moment of impact and fading out.
tips_zh: 慢動作一次只拍一個瞬間，動作不要複雜。
想換成別的瞬間，例如氣球爆開、咖啡倒入杯中，只要改「動作」。
聲音已經設定成慢動作的低沉質感，不用再另外加。

name_zh: 搞笑小短劇（吹牛翻車）
desc_zh: 純文字生成 15 秒搞笑短劇：推銷員吹噓商品很耐用，下一秒商品當場噴發，顧客面無表情吐槽，最後罐頭笑聲。

inputs.default_en: a loud salesman with slicked-back hair in a checkered orange suit
the salesman in the orange suit
a deadpan customer in a grey hoodie and square glasses
the customer in the grey hoodie

inputs.hint_zh: 要會出事的商品，例：果汁機
inputs.default_en: a shiny silver blender whose glass jar is full of strawberries
the blender
pink smoothie

inputs.hint_zh: 例：粉彩色貨架的家電店
inputs.default_en: a cheerful home-appliance shop with bright pastel shelves
這台果汁機堅固到連大象都踩不壞！
那它剛剛為什麼噴到天花板上？
那、那是附贈的特效。

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, bright sitcom lighting, a medium shot in {setting} frames {seller} standing proudly behind a counter with {product} in front, one thumb raised, and {customer} standing at the right with arms crossed. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as {seller_short}, with a loud, fast, theatrical voice (S1), says: <d>[Chinese] {line_seller_1}</d> and slaps the top of {product_short}. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of {product_short} as a finger of {seller_short} presses the start button. The motor whines, the contents churn, the lid blows off with a bang and a fountain of {mess} shoots upward and splatters across the ceiling. [Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of {seller_short} frozen in place with {mess} dripping down the clothes and the hair, while {customer_short} stands perfectly still at the right, not a drop on the clothes, and blinks once. With a flat, dry, low voice (S2), {customer_short} says: <d>[Chinese] {line_customer}</d> [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of {seller_short}, a drop of {mess} falling from the tip of the nose, the smile frozen on the face and one eye twitching. In a strained, high-pitched voice (S1), {seller_short} says: <d>[Chinese] {line_seller_2}</d> A classic canned audience laugh begins right after the line and continues through the final frame.

overall_soundscape: A bright shop ambience with a faint music-box jingle, then the whine of the motor, a loud bang as the lid flies off and a thick splatter across the ceiling. Drips fall onto the floor in slow plops, and a canned audience laugh swells at the end.

non_diegetic_music: A bouncy ragtime-style piano at a quick tempo with a plucked upright bass and a tambourine, cutting abruptly to a single descending trombone slide on the punchline.
tips_zh: 喜劇靠節奏：吹牛、翻車、吐槽、硬拗四拍，每一句都要短。
商品可以換成任何「看起來很穩卻出事」的東西，記得同時改商品簡稱和噴出來的東西。
顧客一定要面無表情，笑點才出得來。

name_zh: 驚悚走廊（不血腥的緊張感）
desc_zh: 純文字生成 10 秒驚悚小片段：廢棄公寓走廊燈光閃爍，主角輕聲呼喊，燈再亮起時遠處的人影更近了，最後全黑。不見血腥。

inputs.default_en: a young woman in a beige raincoat with a shoulder-length black bob, holding a small flashlight
the woman in the beige raincoat

inputs.hint_zh: 例：廢棄公寓走廊，牆紙剝落，頂燈閃爍
inputs.default_en: an abandoned apartment hallway with peeling green wallpaper and flickering ceiling lights

inputs.hint_zh: 要很克制，例：高瘦蒼白的人影
inputs.default_en: a tall, thin, pale silhouette
有人嗎？

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic horror, cold green-grey tones, deep shadows and a single weak flashlight beam, a tracking shot from behind follows {protagonist} walking slowly down {place}, the flashlight beam swaying across the walls and the ceiling lights flickering above. The camera tracks forward at slow speed, keeping a steady distance behind the walker. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the face of {protagonist_short}, who stops mid-step, eyes widening at a faint scraping sound ahead. With a hushed, shaky, breathy voice (S1), {protagonist_short} whispers: <d>[Chinese] {line}</d> The eyes slide slowly to the end of the corridor. [Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a point-of-view shot down the hallway, the flashlight beam trembling on the far wall as the ceiling lights flicker off for a heartbeat. When they return, {figure} stands motionless at the far end of the hallway. The lights flicker off once more, and when they steady again the same silhouette stands noticeably closer than before. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts to a close shot of {protagonist_short}, the flashlight trembling in the hand as every light in the corridor dies at once and the frame falls almost completely dark, with only the faint glint of the eyes and the breath fogging in the cold. The camera holds a static shot until the end.

overall_soundscape: A low air-conditioning rumble and the distant drip of water run under slow footsteps on cracked tile. The ceiling lights buzz and tick as they flicker, a faint scrape comes from ahead and a shaky breath trembles in the cold.

non_diegetic_music: A single sustained low cello note with sparse high string harmonics and no melody, cutting to silence at the final blackout.
tips_zh: 驚悚感來自「克制」：只放一個若隱若現的東西，不要加血或怪物特寫。
燈光閃爍的前後變化是重點，已經寫成『熄滅再亮起，人影更近』。
最後全黑是故意的，留一個想像空間。

name_zh: 奇幻遊戲預告片
desc_zh: 純文字生成 15 秒奇幻動作遊戲預告：廢墟王國遠景、主角特寫與台詞、巨像甦醒、閃避反擊、大標題定格。

inputs.default_en: a lone knight in dented silver armor with a tattered blue cape and a notched longsword
the knight in the blue cape

inputs.label_zh: 大魔王／怪物（第一次出現用）
inputs.default_en: a towering stone golem with glowing orange cracks and moss on its shoulders
the stone golem
a ruined mountain kingdom under a stormy twilight sky, with broken bridges and drifting embers

inputs.label_zh: 遊戲標題（會印在最後一鏡）
inputs.default_en: EMBERFALL
今天，由我來終結這一切。

media.notes_zh: 不需要素材。

template_en:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG, cinematic fantasy game trailer, high-contrast stormy twilight lighting, drifting embers, a wide establishing shot shows {world}, with {monster} half-buried and motionless among the rubble in the distance, its cracks pulsing faintly. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed through the drifting embers. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of {hero}, standing in the foreground wind, ember light flickering over the face. With a low, gravelly, determined voice (S1), {hero_short} says: <d>[Chinese] {line}</d> The grip tightens on the weapon, and the cape snaps behind. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle view as {monster_short} tears itself out of the rubble and rises to full height, stones raining off its body, then throws its head back and bellows. The camera pedestals up with large amplitude at normal speed, and the shockwave of the roar ripples the dust across the ground. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a fast side-tracking view as {hero_short} rolls under a huge swinging fist, comes up and slashes a glowing crack in the leg of {monster_short}, sparks and shards of stone bursting outward. The camera tracks left with large amplitude at fast speed. [Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide view of the ruins as the sky lights with orange fire behind the silhouettes of {hero_short} and {monster_short}, and the title "{title}" appears in large chiseled-stone lettering with rising embers. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed and holds on the title to the end.

overall_soundscape: Howling wind carries embers and distant thunder, stones crack and tumble as the monster rises and a deep, grinding roar shakes the ground. Armor clatters on the roll, steel strikes stone with a ringing impact and debris rains down.

non_diegetic_music: A cinematic trailer score with low sustained strings and slow war drums at a deliberate tempo, building to a layered brass swell and a heavy drum hit at the title, then a single resonant boom that rings out.
tips_zh: 標題字用英文大寫 1 個字，印在畫面上最穩。
打鬥一次只放一次格擋、一次反擊，不要堆很多招。
沒有血腥，想加武器細節就寫在主角外觀裡。

desc_zh: 把上一段影片的最後一格截成圖當第一張，讓新片段從那個畫面接著動，角色、場景、光線延續，並多一句新台詞。

a young woman with short black hair in a yellow raincoat

pushes the door open, a small bell ringing, then steps inside and shakes the drops from the raincoat

我回來了。
